notat: Startup splits into On and Off with a count in each heading, so you can see what actually starts with Windows at a glance. Its two buttons became one that works out whether to turn the ticked entries off or on. Cleanup, Maintenance and Tools have new icons; the last two were both a wrench and hard to tell apart. The sidebar separates Updates from Fix, and the numbers on the front page sit higher in their fields with their bottom lines aligned.
